page.overview:
Who is Eris?

Eris was the mother of Marshall D. Teach and the wife of Rocks D. Xebec, a member of the Davy Family.

Eris was an average-sized woman, with light-colored hair, long bangs, and sharp facial features. She wore a simple light, frilled shirt, and black shorts.

From what was seen, Eris was a kind and caring mother. Even when the situation on God Valley appeared grim, she comforted her son and assured him that everything would be alright. When she and members of the Davy Family were presented to the World Nobles, she shielded Teach from harm. Eris has stated that she likes to handle things on her own and doesn't like clinging to a man when facing danger, which is apparently what made Rocks fall in love with her.

Eris was proud to be part of the Davy Family, even when it put her life into jeopardy. She put all her effect into making sure the Davy bloodline did not end on God Valley by insuring her son survived no matter what. She was supportive of her husband's goals.
